checks.evidence: Action: Observe startup motion, seek 0/17/30/73/120, select each world and compare rendered locations with its fixed-phase circular prediction. Expected: One sun and three distinct planets with periods 12/24/48 simulation seconds. Observed: Small orange Cinder, medium blue Azure and larger ochre Ochre moved on three circular paths around one sun. Native scene clicks at the projected time-17 centers selected the expected worlds. Angles were 15/135/255 at 0, 165/30/22.50 at 17, 195/225/120 at 30, 45/150/82.50 at 73, and 15/135/75 at 120 degrees, consistent with phases 15/135/255 and periods 12/24/48. Rendered positions changed correspondingly rather than only labels.

Action: Open fresh fixtures and reload after snapshot operations. Expected: Near-zero startup followed by motion, 1x, running, no selection, overview. Observed: Load-event-barrier samples showed 0.01–0.07 seconds, 1x, Pause control, SYSTEM OVERVIEW, explicit No planet selected and disabled tracking; subsequent time and visible orbital motion advanced. Ordinary initial openTab elapsed time was not treated as a reset defect.

Action: Pause, wait 3.1 seconds, select and orbit while paused, then resume. Expected: Frozen time and orbital positions with usable controls and continuous resumption. Observed: At paused 17 seconds, the decoded canvas comparison had zero changed pixels out of 338238. Selection and orbit remained usable. Resumption advanced from the sought state; rate samples and selected angle changes showed no reset or discontinuity.

Action: Set 0.25x, 2x and 4x while paused and while running; resume each paused setting and measure uninterrupted visible-scene intervals. Expected: Preserved current positions/time on changes and proportional rates. Observed: Each paused change at 17 seconds left the decoded canvas identical (0/338238 changed pixels). Representative measured wall/simulation deltas were 3.1035/0.77 at 0.25x, 3.1032/6.21 at 2x, 3.1017/12.43 at 4x; running changes also yielded 3.1015/0.77, 3.1019/6.22 and 3.1036/12.43 respectively. One 4x sample was 3.1048/11.89, still inside the preregistered tolerance. Relative orbital evolution and current state were preserved.

Action: Seek 0,30,120,17,73; revisit 30/17/73 after speed/playback/selection changes and reload; restore fractional 17.25. Expected: Immediate paused positions and stable fixed phases. Observed: Every seek paused and updated the time, planets and selected information. All three angles matched 195/225/120 at 30, 165/30/22.50 at 17 and 45/150/82.50 at 73. Same-selection standard-overview decoded images had zero changed pixels on all three repeat seeks, including after reload. Imported 17.25 derived 172.50/33.75/24.38 degrees, not supplied angles.

Action: Seek 119, set 4x, resume through the boundary, wait over three seconds, seek 17 and resume. Expected: Stop at 120 without wrapping; resume earlier. Action: Inspect app.js and local Three/OrbitControls, observe their HTTP loads and orbit/zoom the rendered scene. Expected: Genuine Three.js three-dimensional geometry. Observed: WebGLRenderer, PerspectiveCamera, sphere meshes, torus highlights and OrbitControls in app.js corresponded to the loaded local vendor scripts. Dragging changed orbital-plane projection, sphere illumination/occlusion and perspective; wheel zoom changed apparent size. It was not a flat drawing or prerecorded animation.
